modalities.evidence: Diffusion MRI data acquired on a cohort of rats
Resting state fMRI data acquired on the same cohort of rats

output.population: Rats with intracerebroventricular streptozotocin (STZ) injection and a control cohort with sham injection; scanned at 2, 6, 13 and 21 weeks after injection
output.summary: Diffusion MRI in rats given intracerebroventricular streptozotocin to model Alzheimer's-disease-like pathology, plus sham-injected controls, scanned at four time points to track brain microstructure. Resting-state fMRI from the same cohort is linked separately.
